name: validation_failed
description: validation_failed = true if decision_id is missing after safe normalization, event_type is invalid after safe normalization, learning_eligibility is invalid after safe normalization, or audit_tag is invalid after safe normalization.

name: normalization_applied
description: normalization_applied = true if missing wrapper fields were auto-filled, missing optional blocks were inserted, or an invalid enum was replaced with safe blocked fallback.
